paragraphs.text: These things spake Jesus; and lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, Father, the hour is come; glorify thy Son, that the son may glorify thee:
paragraphs.original: Ταῦτα ἐλάλησεν Ἰησοῦς, καὶ ἐπάρας τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν εἶπεν· Πάτερ, ἐλήλυθεν ἡ ὥρα· δόξασόν σου τὸν υἱόν, ἵνα ὁ υἱὸς δοξάσῃ σέ,
paragraphs.translit: Tauta elalēsen Iēsous, kai eparas tous ophthalmous autou eis ton ouranon eipen· Pater, elēlythen hē hōra· doxason sou ton hyion, hina ho hyios doxasē se,

paragraphs.text: even as thou gavest him authority over all flesh, that to all whom thou hast given him, he should give eternal life.
paragraphs.original: καθὼς ἔδωκας αὐτῷ ἐξουσίαν πάσης σαρκός, ἵνα πᾶν ὃ δέδωκας αὐτῷ δώσῃ αὐτοῖς ζωὴν αἰώνιον.
paragraphs.translit: kathōs edōkas autō exousian pasēs sarkos, hina pan ho dedōkas autō dōsē autois zōēn aiōnion.

paragraphs.text: And this is life eternal, that they should know thee the only true God, and him whom thou didst send, [even] Jesus Christ.
paragraphs.original: αὕτη δέ ἐστιν ἡ αἰώνιος ζωὴ ἵνα γινώσκωσι σὲ τὸν μόνον ἀληθινὸν θεὸν καὶ ὃν ἀπέστειλας Ἰησοῦν Χριστόν.
paragraphs.translit: hautē de estin hē aiōnios zōē hina ginōskōsi se ton monon alēthinon theon kai hon apesteilas Iēsoun Christon.

paragraphs.text: I glorified thee on the earth, having accomplished the work which thou hast given me to do.
paragraphs.original: ἐγώ σε ἐδόξασα ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, τὸ ἔργον τελειώσας ὃ δέδωκάς μοι ἵνα ποιήσω·
paragraphs.translit: egō se edoxasa epi tēs gēs, to ergon teleiōsas ho dedōkas moi hina poiēsō·

paragraphs.text: And now, Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.
paragraphs.original: καὶ νῦν δόξασόν με σύ, πάτερ, παρὰ σεαυτῷ τῇ δόξῃ ᾗ εἶχον πρὸ τοῦ τὸν κόσμον εἶναι παρὰ σοί.
paragraphs.translit: kai nyn doxason me sy, pater, para seautō tē doxē hē eichon pro tou ton kosmon einai para soi.

paragraphs.text: I manifested thy name unto the men whom thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them to me; and they have kept thy word.
paragraphs.original: Ἐφανέρωσά σου τὸ ὄνομα τοῖς ἀνθρώποις οὓς ἔδωκάς μοι ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου. σοὶ ἦσαν κἀμοὶ αὐτοὺς ἔδωκας, καὶ τὸν λόγον σου τετήρηκαν.
paragraphs.translit: Ephanerōsa sou to onoma tois anthrōpois hous edōkas moi ek tou kosmou. soi ēsan kamoi autous edōkas, kai ton logon sou tetērēkan.

paragraphs.text: Now they know that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are from thee:
paragraphs.original: νῦν ἔγνωκαν ὅτι πάντα ὅσα δέδωκάς μοι παρὰ σοῦ εἰσιν·
paragraphs.translit: nyn egnōkan hoti panta hosa dedōkas moi para sou eisin·

paragraphs.text: for the words which thou gavest me I have given unto them; and they received [them], and knew of a truth that I came forth from thee, and they believed that thou didst send me.
paragraphs.original: ὅτι τὰ ῥήματα ἃ ἔδωκάς μοι δέδωκα αὐτοῖς, καὶ αὐτοὶ ἔλαβον καὶ ἔγνωσαν ἀληθῶς ὅτι παρὰ σοῦ ἐξῆλθον, καὶ ἐπίστευσαν ὅτι σύ με ἀπέστειλας.
paragraphs.translit: hoti ta rhēmata ha edōkas moi dedōka autois, kai autoi elabon kai egnōsan alēthōs hoti para sou exēlthon, kai episteusan hoti sy me apesteilas.

paragraphs.text: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for those whom thou hast given me; for they are thine:
paragraphs.original: ἐγὼ περὶ αὐτῶν ἐρωτῶ· οὐ περὶ τοῦ κόσμου ἐρωτῶ ἀλλὰ περὶ ὧν δέδωκάς μοι, ὅτι σοί εἰσιν,
paragraphs.translit: egō peri autōn erōtō· ou peri tou kosmou erōtō alla peri hōn dedōkas moi, hoti soi eisin,

paragraphs.text: and all things that are mine are thine, and thine are mine: and I am glorified in them.
paragraphs.original: καὶ τὰ ἐμὰ πάντα σά ἐστιν καὶ τὰ σὰ ἐμά, καὶ δεδόξασμαι ἐν αὐτοῖς.
paragraphs.translit: kai ta ema panta sa estin kai ta sa ema, kai dedoxasmai en autois.

paragraphs.text: And I am no more in the world, and these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep them in thy name which thou hast given me, that they may be one, even as we [are].
paragraphs.original: καὶ οὐκέτι εἰμὶ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ, καὶ αὐτοὶ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ εἰσίν, κἀγὼ πρὸς σὲ ἔρχομαι. πάτερ ἅγιε, τήρησον αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί σου ᾧ δέδωκάς μοι, ἵνα ὦσιν ἓν καθὼς ἡμεῖς.
paragraphs.translit: kai ouketi eimi en tō kosmō, kai autoi en tō kosmō eisin, kagō pros se erchomai. pater hagie, tērēson autous en tō onomati sou hō dedōkas moi, hina ōsin hen kathōs hēmeis.

paragraphs.text: While I was with them, I kept them in thy name which thou hast given me: and I guarded them, and not one of them perished, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.
paragraphs.original: ὅτε ἤμην μετʼ αὐτῶν ἐγὼ ἐτήρουν αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί σου ᾧ δέδωκάς μοι, καὶ ἐφύλαξα, καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐξ αὐτῶν ἀπώλετο εἰ μὴ ὁ υἱὸς τῆς ἀπωλείας, ἵνα ἡ γραφὴ πληρωθῇ.
paragraphs.translit: hote ēmēn metʼ autōn egō etēroun autous en tō onomati sou hō dedōkas moi, kai ephylaxa, kai oudeis ex autōn apōleto ei mē ho hyios tēs apōleias, hina hē graphē plērōthē.

paragraphs.text: But now I come to thee; and these things I speak in the world, that they may have my joy made full in themselves.
paragraphs.original: νῦν δὲ πρὸς σὲ ἔρχομαι, καὶ ταῦτα λαλῶ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ἵνα ἔχωσιν τὴν χαρὰν τὴν ἐμὴν πεπληρωμένην ἐν ἑαυτοῖς.
paragraphs.translit: nyn de pros se erchomai, kai tauta lalō en tō kosmō hina echōsin tēn charan tēn emēn peplērōmenēn en heautois.

paragraphs.text: I have given them thy word; and the world hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
paragraphs.original: ἐγὼ δέδωκα αὐτοῖς τὸν λόγον σου, καὶ ὁ κόσμος ἐμίσησεν αὐτούς, ὅτι οὐκ εἰσὶν ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου καθὼς ἐγὼ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου.
paragraphs.translit: egō dedōka autois ton logon sou, kai ho kosmos emisēsen autous, hoti ouk eisin ek tou kosmou kathōs egō ouk eimi ek tou kosmou.

paragraphs.text: I pray not that thou shouldest take them from the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil [one].
paragraphs.original: οὐκ ἐρωτῶ ἵνα ἄρῃς αὐτοὺς ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου ἀλλʼ ἵνα τηρήσῃς αὐτοὺς ἐκ τοῦ πονηροῦ.
paragraphs.translit: ouk erōtō hina arēs autous ek tou kosmou allʼ hina tērēsēs autous ek tou ponērou.

paragraphs.text: They are not of the world even as I am not of the world.
paragraphs.original: ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου οὐκ εἰσὶν καθὼς ἐγὼ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου.
paragraphs.translit: ek tou kosmou ouk eisin kathōs egō ouk eimi ek tou kosmou.

paragraphs.text: Sanctify them in the truth: thy word is truth.
paragraphs.original: ἁγίασον αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ· ὁ λόγος ὁ σὸς ἀλήθειά ἐστιν.
paragraphs.translit: hagiason autous en tē alētheia· ho logos ho sos alētheia estin.

paragraphs.text: As thou didst send me into the world, even so sent I them into the world.
paragraphs.original: καθὼς ἐμὲ ἀπέστειλας εἰς τὸν κόσμον, κἀγὼ ἀπέστειλα αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸν κόσμον·
paragraphs.translit: kathōs eme apesteilas eis ton kosmon, kagō apesteila autous eis ton kosmon·

paragraphs.text: And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ὑπὲρ αὐτῶν ἐγὼ ἁγιάζω ἐμαυτόν, ἵνα ὦσιν καὶ αὐτοὶ ἡγιασμένοι ἐν ἀληθείᾳ.
paragraphs.translit: kai hyper autōn egō hagiazō emauton, hina ōsin kai autoi hēgiasmenoi en alētheia.

paragraphs.text: Neither for these only do I pray, but for them also that believe on me through their word;
paragraphs.original: Οὐ περὶ τούτων δὲ ἐρωτῶ μόνον, ἀλλὰ καὶ περὶ τῶν πιστευόντων διὰ τοῦ λόγου αὐτῶν εἰς ἐμέ,
paragraphs.translit: Ou peri toutōn de erōtō monon, alla kai peri tōn pisteuontōn dia tou logou autōn eis eme,

paragraphs.text: that they may all be one; even as thou, Father, [art] in me, and I in thee, that they also may be in us: that the world may believe that thou didst send me.
paragraphs.original: ἵνα πάντες ἓν ὦσιν, καθὼς σύ, πάτερ, ἐν ἐμοὶ κἀγὼ ἐν σοί, ἵνα καὶ αὐτοὶ ἐν ἡμῖν ὦσιν, ἵνα ὁ κόσμος πιστεύῃ ὅτι σύ με ἀπέστειλας.
paragraphs.translit: hina pantes hen ōsin, kathōs sy, pater, en emoi kagō en soi, hina kai autoi en hēmin ōsin, hina ho kosmos pisteuē hoti sy me apesteilas.

paragraphs.text: And the glory which thou hast given me I have given unto them; that they may be one, even as we [are] one;
paragraphs.original: κἀγὼ τὴν δόξαν ἣν δέδωκάς μοι δέδωκα αὐτοῖς, ἵνα ὦσιν ἓν καθὼς ἡμεῖς ἕν,
paragraphs.translit: kagō tēn doxan hēn dedōkas moi dedōka autois, hina ōsin hen kathōs hēmeis hen,

paragraphs.text: I in them, and thou in me, that they may be perfected into one; that the world may know that thou didst send me, and lovedst them, even as thou lovedst me.
paragraphs.original: ἐγὼ ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ σὺ ἐν ἐμοί, ἵνα ὦσιν τετελειωμένοι εἰς ἕν, ἵνα γινώσκῃ ὁ κόσμος ὅτι σύ με ἀπέστειλας καὶ ἠγάπησας αὐτοὺς καθὼς ἐμὲ ἠγάπησας.
paragraphs.translit: egō en autois kai sy en emoi, hina ōsin teteleiōmenoi eis hen, hina ginōskē ho kosmos hoti sy me apesteilas kai ēgapēsas autous kathōs eme ēgapēsas.

paragraphs.text: Father, I desire that they also whom thou hast given me be with me where I am, that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.
paragraphs.original: πάτερ, ὃ δέδωκάς μοι, θέλω ἵνα ὅπου εἰμὶ ἐγὼ κἀκεῖνοι ὦσιν μετʼ ἐμοῦ, ἵνα θεωρῶσιν τὴν δόξαν τὴν ἐμὴν ἣν δέδωκάς μοι, ὅτι ἠγάπησάς με πρὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου.
paragraphs.translit: pater, ho dedōkas moi, thelō hina hopou eimi egō kakeinoi ōsin metʼ emou, hina theōrōsin tēn doxan tēn emēn hēn dedōkas moi, hoti ēgapēsas me pro katabolēs kosmou.

paragraphs.text: O righteous Father, the world knew thee not, but I knew thee; and these knew that thou didst send me;
paragraphs.original: Πάτερ δίκαιε, καὶ ὁ κόσμος σε οὐκ ἔγνω, ἐγὼ δέ σε ἔγνων, καὶ οὗτοι ἔγνωσαν ὅτι σύ με ἀπέστειλας,
paragraphs.translit: Pater dikaie, kai ho kosmos se ouk egnō, egō de se egnōn, kai houtoi egnōsan hoti sy me apesteilas,

paragraphs.text: and I made known unto them thy name, and will make it known; that the love wherewith thou lovedst me may be in them, and I in them.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐγνώρισα αὐτοῖς τὸ ὄνομά σου καὶ γνωρίσω, ἵνα ἡ ἀγάπη ἣν ἠγάπησάς με ἐν αὐτοῖς ᾖ κἀγὼ ἐν αὐτοῖς.
paragraphs.translit: kai egnōrisa autois to onoma sou kai gnōrisō, hina hē agapē hēn ēgapēsas me en autois ē kagō en autois.
